settings.heading: What can I request?
settings.row_content: Almost anything you can describe or point to: something you saw on the street, in a film or on someone's feed. Fashion, design objects, gear, small-batch things. Local and overseas. If it is sold somewhere, we will find where.

settings.heading: How fast?
settings.row_content: Within 60 minutes of your request during concierge hours. You get one email with one verified link. If something will take longer, we tell you before the hour is up.

settings.heading: What does the AI do?
settings.row_content: It reads your request and turns it into a structured sourcing brief: item, style, reference, constraints. Then a human concierge takes over to check the model, seller, stock, price and shipping. AI finds the signal. A person checks the details.

settings.heading: How do I buy?
settings.row_content: Your email links to a ready-to-buy page in this store. Tap Buy now, pay with the methods you already use, and we handle the sourcing and shipping. One item, one checkout.

settings.heading: Which languages?
settings.row_content: English, Korean, Japanese and Spanish. Write in whichever you like. Your link arrives in the same language.
